testcase.name: core validates durations, formats time, and computes the approved clock-shift algorithm
start, pause, and reset preserve accurate state and cycle slots
a completed Focus increments the count, enters memo pending, then auto-starts Short Break
memo skip stores an empty memo and the fourth Focus slot selects Long Break
skipping Long Break resets the cycle and starts Focus
settings apply immediately to Idle sessions but preserve active-session timing
restoring an expired Running session processes exactly one session and waits Idle
restoring a Paused session preserves its snapshot regardless of elapsed wall time
clock-shift detection pauses without changing the last valid remaining snapshot
storage write failures show a warning while timer actions continue
allowed browser notification and synthesized sound are attempted together
failed audio falls back to a changed tab title
test doubles use the standard Node mock facility and leave no pending timer handles
